name: Small-Molecule SPE Agent
description: Calculates fixed-geometry electronic energies for well-defined small molecules such as water, methane, ammonia, and ethanol.
required_inputs: molecular geometry with element identities and coordinate units
validation_checks: charge and multiplicity have valid electron-count parity
method and basis are supported by the selected engine
scientific_constraints: reported value is an electronic energy rather than a free energy
all dimensional quantities carry explicit units
acceptance_criteria: one finite total electronic energy is extracted
input settings and output artifacts are reproducible
capability_boundaries: does not calculate thermal or entropic corrections unless separately requested from a supported environment
does not infer missing chemical identity
recovery_actions: increase SCF iterations within configured limits
use an engine-supported conservative SCF convergence aid without changing method, basis, charge, multiplicity, or geometry
human_review_when: SCF remains unconverged after bounded recovery
